svg.title: K-nucleotide optimization history in elapsed hours, with an exponential fit and the largest measured drops
svg.desc: Blue dots show every full-input candidate cohort. A dashed exponential fits log runtime. Numbered labels identify major changes using their contemporaneous parent comparison.
svg.text: K-nucleotide: the path to Rust parity
125 million bases · complete process including startup · t=0 at the initial ≈218× checkpoint
Elapsed hours since the first completed full-input run
4 Move error work off the hot path
Drop labels compare each change with its contemporaneous parent. The first three highlighted checkpoints are single runs.
All trials are shown, including regressions; the last separate-load trial was not promoted. No small-input or instrumented timings are mixed in.
The ≈218× checkpoint is 216.1647× in the retained receipt. Time comes from process launches; elapsed hours include all intervening gaps.
Both rates and the offset are fitted to all cohorts. This descriptive curve is not a forecast; each ratio uses its own Rust median.
